run_convert_ckpt: run the script to convert an EgoVLP checkpoint to a new format with renamed keys
convert_video_model_keys: convert EgoVLP checkpoint keys from module.video_model to module.visual naming convention
convert_text_model_keys: convert EgoVLP checkpoint keys from module.text_model to module.textual naming convention
convert_projection_keys: convert EgoVLP checkpoint keys from module.txt_proj and module.vid_proj to text_projection and image_projection
save_converted_ckpt: save the converted EgoVLP checkpoint with epoch, state_dict, and best_acc1 metadata
